notes.title: Weapon Bar Update
notes.content: New weapon bar that displays weapons upon switching. This will make it easier to know what weapons you can equip and what their hotkey number is. Update also includes many UI tweaks and a bug fix for Dahkil's quest.

tags.feature: New weapon bar that displays weapons upon switching.

notes.title: FPS Improvement Patch
notes.content:
This update should fix many known areas where FPS would tank. Maximized occlusion culling for all objects on the maps. Some scripts have been removed and others have been fixed for better performance.

Please report if FPS has improved or not. Issues will vary for individual players. Some people are experiencing no issues, others are struggling in random areas.

tags.bug: - Some scripts have been removed and others have been fixed for better performance.
- Maximized occlusion culling for all objects on the maps.

notes.title: Nearing full game release
notes.content:
This is a massive update with many additions and overhauls to the game. This is bringing the game close to leaving early access, as most of the content planned has been added and bug reports have been fixed. As always, please report any new bugs in the steam community or the discord.

Player changes:
Level cap changed from 40 to unlimited.
Weapon upgrade points are now 1 per 3 levels.
New revive potion, able to bring back the player upon a potential death.

World changes:
New lower Vagre map: opened after helping Ghilt in Stormhold. Every playthrough you can visit Vagre for a random additional ghost weapon and regular weapon for purchase at the shops.
New Abandoned City map: A new dungeon area with a relic weapon for Mysana at the end.
New music tracks: northern and western maps now have a new track each, as well as a new track for inside the Vagre castle map.
Town overhaul, new side quests, houses reworked, lighting changes.
New animals to the maps. Farm animals on the Fay Meadows farm, deer to be found in the North Plains.
Added weapon upgrade points to be found on maps.
Inner City Nekropolis additions.
New dungeon under Mara's tavern and well.

Aesthetic changes:
UI overhaul including new ingame cursor and menu polish.
New world map to the pause menu.

notes.title: Large Update for Polish/Fixes
notes.content:
Player changes:
-Pressing block now queues up after attacks, improving the flow of combat.
-Mysana's siphon spell is now twice as fast.
-Most weapons now reach longer on attack.
-Every new game starts off with one life and mana potion.
-Player torch illumination adjusted with less glow making it more visible.

Enemy changes:
-New enemies in hard mode. 
-Zombie warriors have red magic sword spells in normal mode, double swords in hard mode.

World changes:
-New ghost texture shaders.
-Swimming in the north plains, dive into the water now!
-Dahkil's assistant quest updated.
-Many stair collisions reworked that weren't working well with new player controller.
-Dialogue stays on screen if you remain close to NPC after talking to them.
-Window shader rework.
-Tutorial additions.
-Typos fixes, sound reworks, and other bug fixes.

notes.title: Improvement update
notes.content:
-Controller support removed. 
-Controls changed for more fluent gameplay.
-Three new achievements:
    Gaining evil magic protection in Stormhold.
    Performing ten parries.
    Defeating the undead horde in north plains.
-New events and enemies on the way back from Stormhold.
-Final tower additions with new unique relic chest.
-Soul requirement for soul stone upgrades nerfed.
-Teleport stones which were exclusive to hard mode or higher are now available in easy/normal mode.
-Weapon upgrade damage output increased.
-Max potions capacity increased per game difficulty finished.
-New low level mobs in north plains and north road.
-Enemies in graveyard map now slightly nerfed.
-Small UI tweaks.
-Additional tutorials.
-New messages and animations for main quest events.
-Fixed bug that allowed activation of ghost bar early.

notes.title: Content update
notes.content:
New maps:
Big new open world maps with frozen enemies to the far north and burning flame enemies to the west. They will be resistant or weak to magic depending on their type. On these maps are new quests, dungeons and relics to find.

More dynamic movement with magic enemies:
Some of the magic enemies used to move far away from the player and never return, now they're more dynamic and move away/closer depending on the player actions.

Small changes:
-Greatsword overhaul, fire attacks benefit against ice enemies.
-Polearm rework, ice attacks benefit against fire enemies.
-New relic chests that guarantee a relic you don't have.
-Numbers now used as hotkeys for weapons.
-Ghost magic won't drain spirit while zoning.
-Changes to lighting.
-Many small sound adjustments and volume changes.

Bug fixes:
Ashlands portal fixed.
